title: Stop attached-tail scroll settle/repin feedback from blocking prompt sends
outcome: Browser console on workspace deep-link session-5867 shows repeated SessionPaneView scrollToLatestMessage -> settled tick -> pill clear, plus virtualized layout and resize repins. Under scroll tracing this repeatedly captures Error stacks and can monopolize the client while a prompt remains in Sending. Diagnose and bound/deduplicate bottom-follow writes and trace emission without breaking attached-tail behavior.
acceptance: Prompt send stays responsive while attached to a virtualized transcript; redundant stable bottom-follow frames/repins do not generate repeated pill state-change traces; existing scroll-follow behavior and tests remain green.
